shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin dropped 14.3% to $63,572 on June 13, driven by ETF outflows and a hawkish Federal Reserve.
Record $2.97 billion in Bitcoin ETF outflows occurred in early June 2026.
The Fear & Greed Index registered "Extreme Fear" (12/100) on June 12, 2026.
SpaceX's historic IPO initially drained market liquidity, but capital flows are now stabilizing.
Escalating US-Iran tensions contribute to a broader risk-off environment for digital assets.
